# Example Output — Web Filter Recategorisation

*Generated by applying the Web Filter Recategorisation skill to `example-input.md`.*

---

## 1. Diagnosis

Run from the hospital machine:

```text
$ curl -sS https://www.example.com.au
curl: (35) Recv failure: Connection was reset            ← no explanation

$ curl -sSI http://www.example.com.au
HTTP/1.1 403 Forbidden
Server: Zscaler
X-Zscaler-Reason: reasoncode=CATEGORY_DENIED             ← the actual diagnosis

$ curl -sSI https://<swa-default-hostname>.azurestaticapps.net
HTTP/2 200                                               ← control: same site, same origin, fine
```

**Verdict: the filter, not the site.** The default hostname serves the identical content from the identical origin and is allowed; the custom domain is denied by category. Nothing on the server needs changing.

The plain-HTTP request is what made this diagnosable — HTTPS only produced a reset.

**Tooling note:** the agent session on that machine was reporting the same block as a production outage. Live-site verification moved to an unfiltered network for the duration.

## 2. Vendor status

| Vendor | Lookup result | Action |
|---|---|---|
| Zscaler | Miscellaneous or Unknown | **submit** — Health |
| Broadcom / Symantec WebPulse | uncategorised | **submit** — Health, reason "Other" |
| Fortinet | uncategorised | **submit** — Health and Wellness (manual, one URL per request) |
| Palo Alto | Health and Medicine | none needed |
| Cisco Talos | Health and Medicine | none needed |
| Forcepoint | unknown — lookup now requires a customer hub login | cannot submit as a non-customer |

Two vendors had already categorised the domain correctly, which is why the site worked on some networks and not others.

## 3. Submissions made

| Domain | Vendor | Category | Comment |
|---|---|---|---|
| `www.example.com.au` | Zscaler | Health | "Patient-facing health information and practitioner sign-up." |
| `go.example.com.au` | Zscaler | Health | "Redirect host only — all paths 302 to www.example.com.au." |
| both | Broadcom WebPulse | Health | as above, reason "Other" |
| both | Fortinet | Health and Wellness | submitted individually by hand |

**One category per domain.** "Health" alone was requested — no second category such as Software or Business, because some networks deny a site if *any* of its categories is restricted, so a second category can only add risk.

The short-link host was submitted separately: it is its own domain and is categorised independently, even though it holds no content.

## 4. Verification plan

- Re-check all five lookups at +3 days and +7 days.
- Re-test from the hospital machine once Zscaler shows Health: both `curl` forms plus the browser.
- Hold the launch email until the Zscaler lookup reports a category, since that audience is dominated by the blocking network.

## 5. Notes

Forcepoint could not be submitted to — its review tool now sits behind a customer login. If a Forcepoint-filtered network reports a block later, it will need a contact inside that organisation to raise it internally.
